instruction.text: Complete the image of a battle.

trainers.instruction: Whose army do you think was better trained and organised?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: For four years, the Romans tried to take control of Caledonia. The Picts avoided open battles, knowing the Roman army was stronger. Instead, they launched surprise attacks and used their knowledge of the land to withdraw swiftly.
The Picts were eventually forced to unite under a chieftain called Calgacus. They fought in a big battle against the Roman general, Agricola, at Mons Graupius in AD 83, where the Romans won.

hint.label: Did you know?
text: The Battle of Mons Graupius is named after the Grampian Mountains in northern Scotland, though the exact site of the battle is unknown.

atoms.text: Despite the loss, the Picts refused to give up and kept attacking the Romans for years, even as Agricola pressed further into northern territories.

atoms.a: How did the Picts defend themselves against the Romans in the beginning?
b: They did not defend themselves at all.

atoms.a: What two things happened after the Battle of Mons Graupius?

feedback.finish: Remains of Roman forts suggest that, after the battle of Mons Graupius, Roman forces pushed as far north as the modern-day city of Inverness.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in the conversation.

atoms.b: Marcus, we’ve received orders from General ((++Agricola Graupius)). We’re withdrawing south from Caledonia.
atoms.sound: Marcus, we’ve received orders from General Agri-cola. We’re withdrawing south from Caledonia.

atoms.b: Withdrawing? After everything we’ve done? We’ve ((++fought fished)) hard to make it this far.
The ((++tribes Romans)) refuse to surrender, and the harsh land has exhausted our soldiers. Plus, the empire needs troops elsewhere. We need to focus on ((++holding losing)) the south.

atoms.a: Why did the Romans leave Caledonia?
b: They were defeated in a major battle.
++They were ordered to leave by the empire.
++They were tired of fighting the Picts.
